risks.label: Iran War Escalation — Trump Attack in 2-3 Weeks
risks.detail: Trump vowed to hit Iran 'extremely hard' within 2-3 weeks. War Day 33. Strait of Hormuz shut — WTI $107 (+7%), biggest 1-day oil surge of 2026. KOSPI -3.9%, Nikkei -2.1%. Binary risk: attack or ceasefire both create sharp market moves.

risks.label: VIX 26.38 — Rising Into Risk-Off Territory
risks.detail: VIX up from 24.38 to 26.38 (+8.2%). Component score 1.000 — maximum fear signal. Options market pricing sustained uncertainty. War escalation + Hormuz shutdown = dual volatility catalyst.

risks.label: Oil Supply Crisis — Strait of Hormuz Shutdown
risks.detail: WTI $107.10 (+6.97%), Brent $108.69 (+7.44%). Largest 1-day oil surge of 2026. Hormuz carries 20% of global oil supply. Sustained closure = stagflation risk. Refining margins compress while upstream profits surge.

risks.label: Asia Markets Selling Off on War Fears
risks.detail: KOSPI -3.9%, Nikkei -2.1%, Hang Seng -1%. Regional spillover from Iran escalation fears. DXY strengthening to 100.14 (+0.49%) headwind for EM assets. Risk of contagion to EU open.

events.label: Liberation Day Anniversary — April 2
events.detail: 1-year anniversary of original Trump tariffs. Supreme Court ruled tariffs unconstitutional in Feb 2026. Refunds being processed. Less of a binary risk vs. last year — modest positive catalyst for equities.

events.label: Nonfarm Payrolls — April 3
events.detail: Friday NFP is the week's main macro event after yesterday's ADP. Labor market health is the last pillar supporting the consumer. Oil shock could weigh on forward guidance.

events.label: Trump Iran Attack Window — 2-3 Weeks
events.detail: Stated military timeline creates 14-21 day elevated defense stocks window. LMT, NOC, RTX, GD direct beneficiaries. Markets will price in attack risk daily until resolution.

events.label: Gold Pullback After Surge — Entry Window
events.detail: Gold -3.23% to $4,657 on profit-taking after recent surge. Creates optimal pullback entry for GLD ($425-$440) and NEM ($110-$115) before next leg. War premium floor ~$4,500.

opportunities.label: LMT Momentum — Score 92, War Catalyst
opportunities.detail: #1 defense contractor. F-35, THAAD, Javelin, PAC-3 demand surging on Iran war pledge. Entry $615-$620, TP1 $650, TP2 $680. R/R 1:1.5. 5-10d horizon.

opportunities.label: XLE Momentum — Score 91, Oil +7%
opportunities.detail: Energy ETF lagging WTI spot by 2.64% — classic catch-up trade. Hormuz shutdown = sustained oil supply shock. Entry $58-$60, TP1 $64, TP2 $68. R/R 1:1.7.

opportunities.label: NEM Breakout — Score 89, +12% Gold Miner Surge
opportunities.detail: World's largest gold miner. AISC ~$1,400/oz vs gold $4,657 = $3,200/oz margin. Breakout above $110 resistance. Entry $110-$115, TP1 $125, TP2 $135.

opportunities.label: SHEL Breakout — Score 90, Oil Major Near 52W High
opportunities.detail: Shell PLC at $92, only -3% from 52W high ($94.90). WTI $107 directly boosts upstream margins. ~4% dividend yield. Entry $91-$93, TP1 $100, TP2 $108.

opportunities.label: LLY Pullback — Score 91, Healthcare Defensive
opportunities.detail: Eli Lilly +4.17% on war escalation day — textbook defensive rotation. GLP-1 leader (Mounjaro/Zepbound). Entry $945-$960, TP1 $1,010, TP2 $1,060. R/R 1:1.4.

regime_items.label: Risk-Off Regime — Score 0.423
regime_items.detail: Full Risk-Off classification. VIX 1.00, DXY 0.378, credit 0.534, SPX 0.572. Strategy allocation: Pullback 40%, Momentum 35%, Breakout 25%. War escalation + oil shock = stagflation regime characteristics.

regime_items.label: Defensive Rotation Confirmed
regime_items.detail: Top industries: Aluminum +9%, Gold +4%, Defense +3-4%. Worst: Oil Refining -3%, E&P -4%. Institutions rotating from cyclicals/tech to defense, healthcare, gold, staples. Classic Risk-Off playbook.

regime_items.label: Gold $4,657 War Premium Floor
regime_items.detail: Gold pulling back -3.23% on profit-taking but structural floor at $4,500+ supported by Iran war premium + central bank buying + de-dollarization. Miners (NEM) lead on operational leverage.

regime_items.label: USD Safe-Haven Bid — DXY 100.14
regime_items.detail: Dollar reclaiming 100 level (+0.49%). Safe-haven demand offsetting Liberation Day tariff relief. Strong USD = EM headwind. EWJ Japan ETF pullback offers entry on oversold reaction.
